mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1%.
